title: ARK Sentinel — SOC bot
description: Always-on monitoring bot that tails logs, WAF alerts, cloud posture scans and on-chain events, then logs security events (and auto-promotes critical ones to findings) via the dashboard ingest API.
impact: Cuts mean time to detect from days to minutes; every overnight anomaly is now captured and triaged.

title: Foundry audit test harness
description: Reusable Foundry harness with reentrancy, access-control and invariant test templates used across every smart-contract audit.
impact: Every contract finding now ships with a reproducible PoC test; audits are faster and regressions are caught in CI.

title: Secret-scanning CI gate
description: gitleaks pre-commit hook and CI gate that blocks commits containing secrets, added after the hardcoded AWS key incident.
impact: No secret has reached the repo since; developers get instant feedback locally.

title: Semgrep security ruleset
description: Custom Semgrep rules (string-concatenated SQL, dangerous HTML rendering, weak hashing) wired into pull-request checks.
impact: Catches whole classes of vulnerabilities at PR time before they ship.

title: k6 load-test suite & SLO dashboards
description: Reusable k6 load profiles and Grafana SLO dashboards to measure capacity and catch resource-exhaustion regressions.
impact: Capacity limits are now known and alerted on; performance regressions are caught before release.

title: Phishing-resistant MFA rollout
description: Org-wide passkey/FIDO2 rollout plus DMARC/DKIM/SPF enforcement and a one-click report-phish button.
impact: Removes the most common path to account takeover; blocks credential-phishing even when staff are fooled.

title: This security dashboard
description: The ARK STUDIOS Security Operations dashboard itself — engagement/finding tracking, the attack simulator, SOC monitor and presentation mode.
impact: One place for all security work, with automatic attack simulations that make risk legible to non-technical stakeholders.
